testCases: first reads return checking without blocking and start one background probe
stale, available, unavailable, and checking remain distinct
probe errors and timeouts become bounded unavailable health
concurrent fresh requests deduplicate per provider generation
registry and config changes invalidate cached and in-flight generations
daemon status returns promptly while a provider probe hangs
create and continuation fresh-probe only their requested provider
unrelated provider failure cannot block requested-provider lifecycle

commands: npx vitest run <provider-health focused and broader server suites>
npx oxfmt --check <changed TypeScript and manifest files>

patches.upstreamCondition: Submit independently while daemon/provider status synchronously waits on live provider probes or requested-provider lifecycle can be blocked by unrelated provider health.
patches.dropCondition: Remove when the latest stable release provides equivalent nonblocking generation-aware provider health with distinct checking/stale states, bounded deduplicated probes, config invalidation, and requested-provider-only lifecycle gating.
